description: B2B Renewals (partner relationship health) + B2B Documentation (partner onboarding checklist) + wiring B2B employees into the shared Attendance/Leave/Payroll (HRMS) modules. Renewals and Documentation reuse the existing renewals and documentation designs. Attendance/Leave/Payroll are EXTENDED (not rebuilt) so B2B department employees flow through the existing HRMS exactly like other departments, preserving strict owner-only salary visibility.
steps: B2B Renewals route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/renewals.tsx (spec section 16) — partner-relationship-health focus, modeled on src/routes/_authenticated/renewals/index.tsx. Show: Active Partners, Partners with No Recent Referral, Dormant Partners, Partners Due for Follow-up, and per-partner Last Referral, Last Booking, Total Referrals, Total Revenue, Next Follow-up. Drive it off ca_firms + referrals + b2b_followups aggregates (reuse b2b-analytics/b2b-scoring). Allow setting/advancing a follow-up inline. guardRoles(['admin','b2b']).

B2B Documentation route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/documentation.tsx (spec section 17) — partner onboarding checklist reusing the existing Documentation design/components (src/routes/_authenticated/documentation.tsx pattern + its migration 20260514000001). Checklist items: Firm Details, Contact Details, Agreement, Required Documents, Partner Terms, Referral Process Explained, Communication Setup, Onboarding Completed, with a progress percentage, plus Pending Documents, Completed Documents, TAT, Delayed Documents. Add a migration supabase/migrations/20260517000003_b2b_documentation.sql for a b2b_onboarding_tasks/checklist table (idempotent, RLS admin-full + assigned/created b2b-user-scoped) OR reuse the documentation_tasks table with a b2b type flag if that integrates cleanly — prefer a dedicated b2b table to avoid disturbing existing Documentation. Tie each checklist to a ca_firm.

Attendance: add 'Attendance' to the B2B sidebar pointing at the EXISTING /attendance route (My Attendance is already role-agnostic / visible to all). Confirm a user with the b2b role + a linked employees row flows through the existing attendance-punch edge function and HRMS admin screens with NO code change to the punch/geofence logic. If the HRMS employee/department wiring needs the 'B2B' department to exist, ensure a 'B2B' row exists in public.departments (idempotent INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in a small migration if not already present) so admins can assign B2B employees to it. Do NOT modify attendance-punch, hr-requests, or the geofence/server-side validation.

Leave: confirm the existing leave flow (hr-requests edge fn, leave_requests, approvals hub) covers B2B employees unchanged; add the 'Attendance'/leave visibility to B2B users only via the existing shared routes (no new leave system). Admins approve/reject as today.

Payroll: add 'Payroll' to the B2B sidebar. Employees (incl. B2B) must see ONLY their own payroll — reuse the EXISTING HRMS payroll/salary screens and their owner-only RLS (salary_slips/employee_salary are admin-only for reads today; the employee-facing payroll-readiness view shows working days/present/paid-unpaid leave/LOP/hours/status WITHOUT salary figures). If no employee-facing 'My Payroll' summary route exists yet, add a read-only one that surfaces ONLY the current user's own working-days/present/leave/LOP/hours/payroll-status derived from their own attendance (never salary, never other employees), strictly RLS-scoped to self. Admin keeps the full /hrms/salary payroll view. Under NO circumstances expose other employees' salary to a normal/B2B user — mirror the existing salary RLS exactly.

Verify the strict salary isolation: re-read the existing salary RLS (migration 20260516000008) and ensure any new employee-facing payroll view selects only auth.uid()'s own data and does not read salary_slips/employee_salary unless admin. Add a note in the feature findings describing exactly which tables the employee view reads.
Rebuild/commit routeTree.gen.ts. Prettier new files; no new eslint errors on touched files.
acceptance_criteria: B2B Renewals page shows partner-health buckets (active, no-recent-referral, dormant, due-for-follow-up) with per-partner last referral/booking, totals, next follow-up, and inline follow-up update.
B2B Documentation page shows the 8-item onboarding checklist per CA firm with progress %, pending/completed counts, TAT and delayed indicators, reusing the Documentation design.

B2B department employees flow through the EXISTING attendance (geofenced, server-side), leave, and payroll modules with no modification to attendance-punch/hr-requests/geofence logic; 'Attendance' and 'Payroll' appear in the B2B sidebar.
A normal/B2B employee can see only their OWN payroll/working-days/leave/LOP info and NEVER any salary figure of another employee; admin sees all payroll. Salary RLS unchanged and strictly owner-only.
Any new migration (b2b documentation, B2B department row) is additive and idempotent.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds.
verification: Re-read the employee-facing payroll view and confirm it reads only auth.uid()'s own rows and never selects another user's salary; confirm attendance-punch/hr-requests edge functions are byte-unchanged.
findings: Gate green: npx tsc --noEmit clean; bun run test = 229 passed / 17 files (218 after FEAT-007 + 11 new b2b-documentation tests); bun run build ok (~13s); routeTree.gen.ts regenerated + committed (new routes present). Per-file prettier run on all 7 new files; per-file eslint = 0 errors on new files; touched existing files app-shell.tsx (18-count both before/after my stash check = NO new errors; its ~16 real errors are all pre-existing lines I never touched), b2b.ts (clean), b2b-queries.ts (clean after fixing one prettier line in updateOnboarding). DELIVERED THREE PARTS: (1) B2B RENEWALS — src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/renewals.tsx (thin, guardRoles(['admin','b2b'])) -> src/components/b2b/renewals.tsx (code-split heavy component). Drives off the SAME tested roll-up as Partner Performance: listPartnerPerformance() -> partnerPerformanceRows (b2b-performance.ts) -> partnerScore/partnerHealthCategory (b2b-scoring.ts). Buckets: Active Partners (last activity <=45d), No Recent Referral (45-90d), Dormant (>90d or never), Due for Follow-up (pending b2b_followup due today/overdue). Per-partner Last Referral / Last Booking / Total Referrals / Total Revenue / Next Follow-up; inline 'Schedule follow-up' writes a pending b2b_followups row via createFollowup() (RLS-scoped). (2) B2B DOCUMENTATION — src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/documentation.tsx (thin, guardRoles(['admin','b2b'])) -> src/components/b2b/documentation.tsx. Reuses the existing Documentation design (Card/Table/Badge/Checkbox + KPI tiles). 8-item onboarding checklist per CA firm (Firm Details, Contact Details, Agreement, Required Documents, Partner Terms, Referral Process Explained, Communication Setup, Onboarding Completed) with live progress %, plus KPI tiles Pending / Completed Documents, Avg TAT, Delayed. New dedicated additive table public.b2b_onboarding (migration supabase/migrations/20260517000003_b2b_documentation.sql) tied to ca_firm (FK ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE(firm_id)); 8 boolean columns; completed_at stamped by a trigger (b2b_onboarding_stamp_completed) so TAT = created_at->completed_at (or ->now while open). Idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, DROP POLICY IF EXISTS before CREATE, trigger fn via CREATE OR REPLACE, reuses existing public.b2b_touch_updated_at from 20260517000002). RLS: admin-full + B2B owner-scoped exactly like the FEAT-002 child tables — a b2b user reaches a checklist only through firm ownership (ca_firms.owner/assigned_to/created_by) or by being the checklist's assigned_to/created_by. New hand-written type B2BOnboarding + ONBOARDING_ITEMS constant in src/lib/b2b.ts; query helpers listOnboarding/getOnboardingForFirm/ensureOnboarding/updateOnboarding in b2b-queries.ts (all via b2bDb()); pure tested maths in src/lib/b2b-documentation.ts (+ b2b-documentation.test.ts, 11 tests): onboardingProgress (completed/percent/isComplete/tatDays/isDelayed), summarizeOnboarding (pending/completed/delayed/avgTat/avgPercent), completedItemIds, daysBetween. (3) ATTENDANCE / LEAVE / PAYROLL for B2B employees — EXTENDED the shared HRMS, nothing rebuilt. Seeded the missing 'B2B' row into public.departments (idempotent INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING, inside the FEAT-008 migration) so admins can assign B2B employees; the 8 HRMS departments from 20260516000005 are untouched. Attendance: B2B staff use the EXISTING role-agnostic /attendance route (already in NAV for all) and the existing attendance-punch edge fn / geofence UNCHANGED. Leave: existing hr-requests edge fn + leave_requests + approvals hub cover B2B unchanged (no new leave system). Payroll: added a NEW employee-facing read-only route src/routes/_authenticated/my-payroll.tsx (role-agnostic like /attendance; appended 'My Payroll' to NAV so it shows for B2B and everyone). It surfaces ONLY the current user's own working-days/present/half-day/absent/paid+unpaid-leave/LOP/paid-days/hours/overtime/payroll-status, reusing buildEmployeeMonth + MonthStatsGrid + LeaveBalance (attendance-queries.ts / attendance-month.tsx) and lopDays() from the tested payroll.ts; the admin keeps the full /hrms/salary view. CRITICAL SALARY ISOLATION — VERIFIED: my-payroll.tsx reads ONLY public.employees (own row; RLS employees_select limits to profile_id = auth.uid()), public.hr_settings + public.holidays (reference, read-to-all), public.attendance (own; attendance_select scopes to employee_id in own employees ids) and public.leave_requests (own; fetchLeaves filters employeeId = own id, RLS enforces). It reads NO salary table: grep confirms the route never references salary_slips or employee_salary, and those tables remain admin-only-for-reads (20260516000008 unchanged) so even a direct REST call by a normal/B2B user returns nothing. No salary figure (basic/HRA/net/etc.) is ever rendered — only day/hour counts + a 'In progress / Month closed' status; a footer states salary slips are shared by the admin. CONFIRMATIONS: attendance-punch/index.ts and hr-requests/index.ts edge functions are byte-unchanged (git status on supabase/functions/ empty); NO existing HRMS or B2B migration modified (git status on supabase/migrations/ shows only the new 20260517000003 file); the 'B2B' departments row is seeded idempotently. GOTCHAS for any follow-up: (a) b2b_onboarding.completed_at is trigger-managed — never set it from the client; updateOnboarding only toggles item booleans/notes/assigned_to. (b) The migration must be applied by the owner AFTER 20260517000002 (it depends on ca_firms + public.b2b_touch_updated_at); it is additive/idempotent and safe to re-run. (c) Like all B2B tables, b2b_onboarding is absent from generated types.ts, so it goes through b2bDb() + the hand-written B2BOnboarding type. (d) Nav kept FLAT and surgical: appended 'My Payroll' after 'My Attendance' and 'B2B Renewals'/'B2B Documentation' at the end of the B2B group; no existing file re-prettiered.
